purpose: Provisional descriptive metrics for the full 3,168-record WinoBias run; one seed; pending manual review. These are not final reproduction results.
osb_denominator_convention: sentences of given gender containing the occupation as a candidate; local operationalization
failure_policy: failed executions excluded from rates but counted explicitly; invalid generated answers counted as incorrect

notes: The review flag marks a local parser convention and does not by itself mean that the source example is invalid.
The main aggregate includes all 3,168 source records, as selected for this run.
RPA and A-SB are local descriptive calculations; generated answers, normalization and comparison with the article remain under manual review.
No additional seeds or significance tests are included in this run.
audit_metadata.correlation_scope_note: The paper reports the main correlation over occupation-level O-SB on the WinoBias set; Type 1 and Type 2 correlations are included here as separate local analyses. All are single-seed descriptive values; no p-values are computed.
